recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the active current-source omission for FHIR-8303 and corrects the adjacent operation-specific wording without changing parameter names, cardinalities, or conformance mechanics.
issue_request: FHIR-8303 was Published/Persuasive for the ValueSet $expand operation. It asked why valueSet can be supplied as an input parameter when the client already has the value set, and the accepted resolution was to add: "This parameter is used when the client wants the server to expand a value set that is not stored on the server".
initial_application: SVN revision 5482, imported as git commit 71896e54b3, was titled "#8303 - clarification of Valueset.Expand parameter" and the Jira comment says it applied the requested sentence. The patch actually added the sentence to the old spreadsheet row for validate-code.valueSet while leaving expand.valueSet unchanged; later source rework split the spreadsheet into OperationDefinition XML files and preserved that state.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini, and source/valueset/list-ValueSet-operations.xml references both OperationDefinition/ValueSet-expand and OperationDefinition/ValueSet-validate-code. Searches for FHIR-8303 and the valueSet/expand/not-stored terms found no relevant Zulip or Confluence discussion and no later Jira decision superseding the Published resolution.
reconciliation: Added the accepted not-stored-on-server clarification to source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml for the $expand valueSet input. Also changed the directly related $validate-code valueSet sentence from asking the server to expand a value set to validating a coded value against a value set, removing the misleading artifact of the historical wrong-row application.
source_changes: source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-expand.xml: added the accepted FHIR-8303 not-stored-on-server clarification to the $expand valueSet input documentation.
source/valueset/operationdefinition-ValueSet-validate-code.xml: changed the adjacent valueSet documentation from expanding a value set to validating a coded value against an unstored value set.
